name: Implicit_Certificate_Via_Constraint_Relaxation
description: Instead of explicitly giving the mathematical formulas for the three independent bounds (p1+p2, sum(p1), sum(p2)), the problem now defines them implicitly by describing three hypothetical scheduling scenarios where specific safety constraints are suspended. The model must logically deduce that relaxing grid capacity yields max(p1+p2), relaxing precedence and init capacity yields sum(p1), and relaxing precedence and cap capacity yields sum(p2).
